# Offerbook and blocklist samples

`offerbook-all-states.cbor` and `blocklist-entries.cbor` were generated by the actual v0.2.3 source at `dfa1423b5b0b7e9a68d191d4488fdc3d64bb3b15`.

The offerbook covers all 13 frozen state/reason combinations in visible and suppressed entries. Every entry has a populated offer, bond, certificate hash and valid ECDSA signature. The blocklist covers two valid regtest addresses with both populated and missing labels.

To regenerate into an empty output directory, extract that tag into a temporary directory. Insert [offerbook-generate.rs](offerbook-generate.rs) before the closing brace of `src/taker/offers.rs::tests`, and [blocklist-generate.rs](blocklist-generate.rs) before the closing brace of `src/blocklist.rs::tests`. Set `OPENSWAP_COMPAT_FIXTURES` to the output directory, then run:

```sh
cargo test --manifest-path /tmp/openswap-v023/Cargo.toml --lib generate_v023_offerbook_fixture
cargo test --manifest-path /tmp/openswap-v023/Cargo.toml --lib generate_v023_blocklist_fixture
```

No node runs. The samples use fixed test keys and values. The checked-in bytes remain immutable inputs to future readers.
